title: Lightly Flaky Middle Eastern Lamb Shawarma
description: A quick-fix middle-eastern dish featuring lamb, applesauce, and a mantecare-emulsify sauce, all wrapped in a low-carb friendly shawarma form. This recipe is perfect for a delicious and healthy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together manteca, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Add the sliced lamb to the bowl and toss to coat with the mantecare-emulsify sauce.
Grill the lamb for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Warm the low-carb pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading a layer of applesauce on each pita, followed by a few slices of lamb, some shredded lettuce, and diced tomato.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the lamb in the microwave or oven before serving.
Consider serving with additional toppings such as pickled turnips or cucumber sauce.
